name: fetch-firecrawl-fallback
description: Makes WebFetch survive anti-bot walls: on a 403 or a challenge page it retries with the Firecrawl CLI, then Claude in Chrome, and the agent sees an ordinary WebFetch result.

firecrawl.title: Use the Firecrawl CLI
firecrawl.description: Second rung: `firecrawl scrape`. Needs the CLI installed and logged in (`firecrawl login`, or FIRECRAWL_API_KEY in the environment).

firecrawl_bin.title: Firecrawl CLI command
firecrawl_bin.description: Path or name of the firecrawl executable.

chrome.title: Use Claude in Chrome as the last resort
chrome.description: Needs the Claude in Chrome extension connected. Runs in a throwaway tab that is closed afterwards.

model.title: Model that applies the prompt
model.description: WebFetch runs your prompt over the page with a small model. The fallback does the same with this one, outside the agent's context.

max_chars.title: Page characters kept
max_chars.description: A longer page is cut here and the result says how to continue with offset.

challenge_wait_s.title: Chrome challenge wait (s)
challenge_wait_s.description: How long to let a 'checking your browser' interstitial clear in Chrome before giving up.

skip_hosts.title: Hosts never sent to a third party
skip_hosts.description: Comma-separated host suffixes (example.com) that skip Firecrawl. Private, local and credentialed URLs are always skipped.
